**Finding: Compliant** — no redline required.

The agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant on Meridian Fieldworks. § 12.3 goes further in our favour by expressly confirming that Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment" and preserving our right to hire any person responding to general recruitment. § 30.1 addresses only Vendor's responsibility for its own personnel and adds no restriction on us. This meets the playbook's preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so the fallback (narrow mutual 12-month non-solicit with general-advertising carve-out) is not needed.
